prompts.spec: Create a polished 2D game-sprite animation contact sheet preserving the reference's exact three character identities, outfits, props, proportions, front-facing three-quarter camera, warm painterly rendering, and black-background presentation. Layout exactly 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, no text, labels, or borders, pure flat black background, wide clean gutters, full bodies safely contained. Rows: Player Upgrades, Gear Merchant, Bobo dog merchant. Within every row, left to right: neutral planted idle, tiny anticipation, localized motion peak, soft settle almost matching frame 1. Use an identical fixed camera, apparent scale, lighting, and placement; both boot soles or paws remain on the same baseline and horizontal coordinates; pelvis, torso centerline, shoulders, and overall silhouette stay fixed. No walking, stepping, body bob, bounce, squash/stretch, zoom, lateral sway, lean, turn, or whole-body rotation. Player: slow blink, small goggle/finger movement, faint cylinder pulse, tiny tool or coat-tail settle. Gear: slow blink, beard settle, helmet-lamp pulse, restrained strap hand, pouch or pickaxe follow-through. Bobo: slow blink, ear perk and recovery, small tail swish, tiny bottle or medallion follow-through, scarf or fur breathing. Adjacent frames must read clearly at game scale but remain subtle and natural.
